text:
Reprints 
Dow industrials led stock futures to mild gains early Thursday, as the market looked to extend its first rally of 2018 and as cities and business across the East were slowed by a blustery winter storm. 
X Futures for the Dow Jones industrial average ticked up almost 0.2% above fair value, Nasdaq 100 futures were up slightly more than 0.1%. S&P 500 futures traded incrementally higher, up less than 0.1%. Small caps outpaced, lifting Russell 2000 0.3% above fair value. Intel, Tesla under Pressure; AMD, SVB Financial Early Risers 
General Electric ( GE ) took up its default position, rising 1% to lead the Dow as futures for most of the index stocks trended quietly higher. Merck ( MRK ) was next in line, up 0.8% in premarket trade. 
Intel ( INTC ) traded down nearly 2%, continuing to feel pressure from discovery of the flaw dubbed 'Meltdown,' a chip operating system lapse which potentially permits hackers access to the memory of a computer or other device . Intel had pared a steep early loss to around 3% in very heavy trade on Wednesday, suggesting some support at the stock's 10-week moving average. 
Alphabet's ( GOOGL ) Google Project Zero researchers also found a second chip flaw, Reuters reported, which they named Spectre. The second security flaw affects specific chips from Intel, AMD ( AMD ) and Softbank's ( SFTBY ) ARM, putting devices using those chips at risk of security breach. 
AMD traded nearly 3% higher in premarket action. A two-day rally left shares up more than 12% for the short week through Wednesday, but the advance pulled back after meeting resistance at the stock's 10-week moving average. 
Micron Technology ( MU ) tacked on a 1.4% gain. The Boise, Idaho-based chipmaker retook support at its 10-week moving average on Wednesday, as it moved further up the right side of flat base with a 49.99 buy point. 
IBD Leaderboard stock SVB Financial ( SIVB ) grabbed an early 1.8% gain. The northern California-based bank is extended above a 223.92 entry in a nine-month saucer-with-handle base. 
Apple ( AAPL ) rose 0.3%, edging closer to an attempt to retake a buy point at 176.34. The FANG stock tech leaders all traded higher, with Netflix ( NFLX ) once again heading up the group with a 0.5% gain. Netflix ended Wednesday in buy range, less than 1% above a flat base buy point at 204.48 . 
Another high tech leader, Tesla ( TSLA ), slumped almost 3% ahead of the open, following a 1% decline in weak trade Wednesday. The maker of luxury battery-powered vehicles reported on Wednesday its fourth-quarter manufacturing and deliveries fell far short of guidance, and it pushed back its guidance for upcoming deliveries in 2018 . 
Shares of the stock are down about 19% from a September high, and struggling to maintain support at their 10-week line. 
Retail pharmacy chains Rite-Aid ( RAD ) dropped 5%, Walgreens Boots Alliance ( WBA ) slipped 1.6% after reporting quarterly results. Coming Up: National Employment, Weekly Unemployment Claims 
Wednesdays economic news kicks off with the ADP National Employment Report, due out at 8:15 a.m. ET. Weekly unemployment numbers are expected from the Labor Department at 8:30 a.m. ET. A services purchasing managers index for DEcember is set for release from Markit at 9:45 a.m. ET. 
The Energy Information Administration reports weekly inventories data for natural gas at 10:30 and for oil at 11 a.m. ET.
